items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: I used to go to school with him and I used to beat him every day and take his lunch.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. That's close. George went to a private school. He said, Professor Medard Nelson, do you remember his name? Medard. Medard Nelson.
I would talk of him, but I forgot even what the school was. Medard.
That was somewhere on Burgundy, I think. Oh yeah. By a mother for Cabrini's.
